newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania mth/mth inflation eases to 2.4 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Romania mth/mth inflation eases to 2.4 pct in Sept.

text.p: Romanian monthly inflation slowed to 2.4 percent in September from 3.8 percent in August, the National Statistics Board said on Wednesday.
But year-on-year inflation quickened to 45.3 percent in September from August's 44.2 percent, with the nine-month consumer price rise at 30.1 percent, up from 27.0 percent over January-August.
The 1996 government forecast for 12-month inflation is 30 percent, up from a target of 20 percent agreed with the IMF, but economists expect inflation to be much higher than forecast.
Central bank governor Mugur Isarescu recently said year-on-year inflation would be 35 percent this year, while local analysts project it at some 45 percent.
